headline: Hot Money Floods In, Stocks and Currency Both Rise; NT Dollar Intraday Breaks Into 31.6, Up for Fourth Straight Day
summary: AI-related themes drew hot money into Taiwan, lifting stocks and the currency. The Taiwan stock market hit record intraday and closing highs, and the New Taiwan dollar strengthened to 31.6 per US dollar intraday.
why: Taiwan's stock market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor and AI hardware makers, and the currency influences the returns of foreign investors.
why_moved: Hot money flowed into Taiwan on AI themes, lifting both equities and the New Taiwan dollar to record or multi-day highs.
